blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several areas in Metro Manila were submerged in floodwaters on Friday afternoon, Sept. 18, due to heavy rainfall brought by localized thunderstorms, the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) reported. In an advisory, the MMDA reported the following flooded areas, as of 1:57 p.m.: Quezon City Gutter-deep, up to 8 inches (passable to all types of vehicles): Tire-deep, up to 10 inches (passable to all types of vehicles): Pasig City Gutter-deep, up to 8 inches (passable to all types of vehicles): Above gutter-deep (passable to all types of vehicles): Manila Gutter-deep, up to 8 inches (passable to all types […]...
